subject.title: Update 2026.3.24 silently drops config when HOME changes

question: When an updater runs with a different HOME than the installed Linux systemd gateway service, should OpenClaw block, preserve the prior service root, or migrate config/state automatically?
rationale: The code can detect the mismatch, but the permanent behavior controls cross-user credential-bearing config access and could conflict with existing stale-service-env hardening.

options.title: Block and require explicit migration
options.body: Detect the mismatch, stop before rewriting service/config roots, and print a Doctor/setup command that the operator must run in the intended user context.

options.title: Preserve matching prior root
options.body: Reuse the prior service HOME/config roots only when ownership and service identity match a strict safe policy.

options.title: Automatic backed-up migration
options.body: Move or copy the old config/state into the new root with backups, audit output, and strict ownership checks.

recommendation.title: Block and require explicit migration
recommendation.body: Detect the mismatch, stop before rewriting service/config roots, and print a Doctor/setup command that the operator must run in the intended user context.

likelyOwner.reason: The central update/service restart path and recent related history point to steipete as the best available routing owner for the security/product choice.
